'''Sensor monitor''' was a position held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Godherdt]] was a sensor monitor on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].
